title: Solo de Concours
identity: The saxophone edition of Henri Rabaud’s Solo de Concours is arranged by Harry Gee for alto saxophone and piano; Hal Leonard lists 16 pages and a Grade/Level 5 publisher classification. The original Solo de Concours, Op.10, was a clarinet Conservatoire competition piece. This is a transcription, and the saxophone edition should be evaluated separately from the clarinet original.

evidence.claim: Bibliothèque nationale de France record identifies Rabaud’s Solo de Concours Op.10 as a work for clarinet and documents its Conservatoire commission.
Hal Leonard identifies the Harry Gee alto saxophone edition, Southern Music, 16 pages, Grade/Level 5.

review_focus: Compare the saxophone arrangement’s register, articulation, breath/phrase requirements and piano reduction against the clarinet original; do not transfer clarinet range or difficulty assumptions.
collection_flag: Transcription/arrangement of a clarinet Conservatoire competition work. The saxophone edition has a separate publisher level label and may retain a lyrical contest-solo character; actual score not inspected.
